---
title: "World Flags"
format: html
resources:
  - w2560
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
# Send the list of PNG filenames in w2560/ to Observable JS
ojs_define(flag_files = list.files("w2560", pattern = "\\.png$"))
```

```{ojs}
// Create a dropdown menu of flag filenames, defaulting to United States.png
viewof selected_flag = Inputs.select(flag_files, {
  label: "Select a flag:",
  value: "United States.png"
})

// Display the selected flag image from the w2560/ folder
html`<img src="w2560/${selected_flag}" style="max-width: 600px; border: 1px solid #ccc; margin-top: 1rem;">`
```
